Read your level in the Analytical Assurance Decision Tool you used in step 1. If any impact
dimension scores Level 4, your level is Level 4 BCA at every likelihood. The Analytical Quality and
Assurance Lead confirms a Level 4 BCA level.

Score the likelihood now, at scoping, before you finish with the tool:

- score the six likelihood dimensions against the data and the method you intend to use
- score them again at design if either changes materially

Use [score the likelihood](/guidance/07-deciding-your-assurance-level/score-the-likelihood.qmd) for the scales.

The Analytical Risk Assessment and Quality Assurance Framework may escalate work to Business
Critical Analysis. If it does and the work was not designated, score the six impact dimensions
again with your commissioner. The work is Business Critical only if a dimension then scores Level 4.
